title: Paper Appraisal
description: ADVISORY outward per-paper appraisal — the venue 7-dimension rigor rubric RE-POINTED OUTWARD at an EXTERNAL paper being READ (a reading aid), NOT inward at the machine's own manuscript (that is venue_review). It is purely advisory: a reviewer-mode reading record. It carries NO verdict / accept / reject / cut / decision / meets_bar / status field and NEVER governs a gate or decides anything — additionalProperties:false makes any such self-decision field structurally impossible. The dimension scores, checklist, and prose fields are evidence for the reader, never a release verdict.

source_ref.description: Reference to the external paper being appraised (file path, [[slug]], DOI, or artifact id).

paper_type.description: Paper category, used to select the right appraisal lens / reporting standard. null when unclassified.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension rigor scores on the 7-D venue rubric, re-pointed outward at the read paper. Advisory only — never aggregated into a verdict here.

dim.description: Which of the 7 rubric dimensions this score applies to.

evidence_ref.description: Optional pointer (section/figure/table ref) justifying the score. null when not anchored.

note.description: Optional free-text justification for this dimension's score.

assumptions.description: Implicit, load-bearing assumptions the paper relies on (whether or not it states them).

limitations_unacknowledged.description: Limitations the paper does NOT state but that matter for trusting its claims.

baseline_fairness.description: Reviewer-mode prose: are the baselines strong, current, and fairly tuned/compared?

ablation_sufficiency.description: Reviewer-mode prose: do ablations isolate each component's contribution?

statistical_robustness.description: Reviewer-mode prose: are results reported with variance / significance / adequate runs?

selective_reporting.description: Reviewer-mode prose: signs of cherry-picking, missing negative results, or favorable-only metrics.

reproducibility_gaps.description: Specific gaps that would block an expert from reproducing the main results.

generalization.description: Reviewer-mode prose: how far the claims plausibly generalize beyond the reported setting.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions a reviewer would raise — the things the reader should resolve before trusting the paper.

checklist.description: Optional paper-type-selected formal reporting checklist. null when no standard applies.

standard.description: Which formal reporting / risk-of-bias standard this checklist instantiates.

items.description: Per-item status against the chosen standard.

status.description: Whether the paper meets this item.

note.description: Optional evidence / caveat for this item's status.

medical_imaging_checklist.description: Optional high-value medical imaging / clinical AI appraisal checklist for imaging papers. Used by read_paper_deep PASS checks when the active domain profile is medical imaging.

item_id.description: Local item-bank id, e.g. CLAIM-MI-01 or CROSS-MI-LEAKAGE.

overall.description: One-paragraph reviewer-mode summary of the paper's standing — prose only, ADVISORY. NOT a verdict/accept/reject; it never decides anything.
